description: Implementation of CategoryService for managing categories, including adding, reading, and deleting categories with associated image file handling.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing category management operations including add, read, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new category with an uploaded image, saves it to the repository, and returns a response object.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves all categories and converts them to response objects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category by ID, including removing its associated image file from the filesystem.

methods.name: convertToResponse
methods.description: Converts a CategoryEntity to a CategoryResponse, including item count.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a CategoryRequest to a CategoryEntity, assigning a new UUID.
